title: 국회의원선거구획정위원회 구성 및 운영 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 국회의원선거구획정위원회 구성 및 운영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the composition and operation of the National Assembly Election District Delimitation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee"), as delegated to the National Assembly Regulations by Article 24 (11) of the Public Official Election Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"). <Amended on July 2, 2007>
